description: How the apps reach the stops of the city networks (pack-roles-v1.json, urbanPacks) on foot: a station and a city stop at most maximumWalkMeters apart (straight line) are joined by a walk, timed at walkingSpeedKmh, rounded up to the minute, plus walkMarginMinutes; stops of one name at most samePlaceMeters apart are one place; a stop picked in the search is boarded at its platforms, the stops of the same name at most platformMeters from it.
